name: Kubelet Protects Kernel Defaults
description:
Ensures protectKernelDefaults: true, so the kubelet refuses to start if kernel parameters differ from its hardened expectations rather than silently changing them. Reads /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml; passes with LEA_RULE_no_service when no kubelet is running.
Required sudo rule: allow user lea to run ONLY this exact command without a password: lea ALL=(root) NOPASSWD: /bin/cat /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml

validation.command: if cat /proc/*/comm 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^kubelet$'; then cat /var/lib/kubelet/config.yaml 2>/dev/null; echo LEA_KUBELET; else echo 'LEA_RULE_no_service'; fi
